Studio.dc.html.title: Studio — add a new subdomain (local dev only)

n-previews.text: Previews: the card art is CSS-drawn for now. The build's Playwright script (PRD §5.5) replaces it with real light/dark screenshots. Ad/analytics hosts are blocked during capture.

n-ads.text: Ad slots are drawn as reserved, labelled boxes. Real units are added only after AdSense approval — until then the space collapses. Never adjacent to cards or CTAs.

n-open.text: 5 public apps shown (docs/subdomains.md). Verdict is private (friends only) — hidden from the catalog, listed in Studio as 'private'. Empty categories (Apps) hide their chip. Tagline: 'Side projects, small tools & games.' Hosted on GitHub Pages — static only.

n-theme.text: Theme: header button cycles light → dark → auto (existing behaviour). Try it in Play on the home and detail boards.

n-studio.text:
Adding apps (PRD §5.8): one core script, three doors —
1. Studio (this board), only under `npm run dev`, never deployed
2. CLI: npm run catalog:add -- <sub>
3. GitHub Action 'Add app' → opens a PR (works from phone)
All write src/data/catalog.yaml + previews. Merge = deploy.

n-studio-try.text: Try it in Play: type a subdomain (try 'verdict' to see the duplicate check), Fetch, fill tagline + 150-word description to unlock Publish.
